answer: The crystal is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the zephyr. The dawn of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
